[size=4]Hello everyone! this is the first mod I've created and I wanted to make it a themed furniture mod because I love decorating my farm and I wanted to share, so I present you...[/size]

[b][size=5] ‿୨˚̣̣̣͙୧‿ Soft Boho Decor for your Bedroom ‿୨˚̣̣̣͙୧‿ [/size][/b]
[i][size=3][font=Georgia](but yeah, you can use the items however you want)[/font][/size][/i]

[/size][/b][/center]
[center][size=4][b]・・・۶ৎ・・・Description・・・۶ৎ・・・[/b][/size][/center]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=4]This mod has 18 items:[/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]✿ small bed  (interactive) [/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]✿ large bed  (interactive) [/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]✿ small bench (just decorative)[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]✿ coffee table
✿ two nightstands
✿ lamp in a small table[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]✿ macrame wall decor[/color]
✿ wall hanging plant
✿ roses painting
✿ small rug
✿ meduim rug
✿ large rug
✿ couch (interactive)
✿ round flower vase
✿ large flower base
✿ small chair (interactive)
✿ dresser (interactive)

[center][i]----- This mod adds furniture, it doesn't replace any vanilla original items  -----[/i][/center]

[center][b]₊˚ ✧ ━━━━⊱⋆⊰━━━━ ✧ ₊˚[/b] [/center]

[center][size=4][b]・・・۶ৎ・・・ Installation instructions ・・・۶ৎ・・・
[/b][/size][/center]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This mod doesn't require anything complicated, download - unzip file - copy the folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder. [/color][/size]

[center][color=#D4D4D8][b]₊˚ ✧ ━━━━⊱⋆⊰━━━━ ✧ ₊˚[/b] [/color][/center]

[center][size=4][b]・・・۶ৎ・・・ Main features ・・・۶ৎ・・・
[/b][/size][/center]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]You will be able to purchase each item from Robin's shop directly.[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Note: Each item can be bought once a day, the next day all the items you already purchased will be in stock again. [/color][/size]

[center][b]₊˚ ✧ ━━━━⊱⋆⊰━━━━ ✧ ₊˚[/b] [/center]

[center][size=4][b]・・・۶ৎ・・・ Requirements ・・・۶ৎ・・・
[/b][/size][/center]
[color=#D4D4D8]You will need SMAPI, that's it. And well yeah, Stardew Valley 1.6+.[/color]

[center][color=#D4D4D8][b]₊˚ ✧ ━━━━⊱⋆⊰━━━━ ✧ ₊˚[/b] [/color][/center]

I'll continue learning and creating more.
